sloka: सत्येन लोकान् जयति दीनान् दानेन राघवः ।गुरून् शुश्रूषया वीरो धनुशा युधि शात्रवान् ॥२-१२-२९॥
transliteration: satyena lokān jayati dīnān dānena rāghavaḥ ।gurūn śuśrūṣayā vīro dhanuśā yudhi śātravān ॥2-12-29॥

translations.english: Rama is a hero who wins over the people by his truthfulness, the poor by charity, the preceptors by his service and the enemies in the battle by the power of his bow.
